test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The unique school visit campaign ‘Meet the Champions’ was jointly organised by which of the following ministries?

options.text: Ministry of Education and Ministry of Women and Child Welfare
Ministry of Education and Ministry of Youth Affairs
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Ministry of Women and Child Welfare
Ministry of Youth and Ministry of Ayush

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Education and Ministry of Youth Affairs**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Youth Affairs and Sports Ministry will organise - the **'Meet the Champion' initiative in 26 schools across the country** on the occasion of **National Sports Day On 29 August 2022.**
 
• PM Modi’s unique school visit campaign ahead, **‘Meet the champion Programme**’ aims to prepare and connect the young school students with the champions.
 
• The aim is to acknowledge and ready them with champion qualities to face the world in any sphere of life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A few of the prominent athletes who will be part of the initiative are the** Commonwealth Games and World Championships Gold Medalist.**
 
• Olympic Gold** medallist Neeraj Chopra **started off the ambitious ‘Meet the Champions’ programme that connects India’s ace athletes with school children when he interacted with students from ove**r 75 schools at Sanskardham, Ahmedabad.**
